assessment.explanation: All four methods returned the same complete join. Smaller-side hashing is a known heuristic. Operation and auxiliary-row counts describe this workload; timings are single local observations. Independent confirmation and economic benefit remain unestablished.

measurementNotes: Keys are exact, case-sensitive strings; no trimming or numeric conversion. Duplicate keys preserve every matching row pair.
A conflict means unequal exact text in a shared non-key column, not evidence that either catalog is wrong.

Logical operations count key comparisons, indexed-row insertions, hash probes, and emitted pairs. They omit string length, hashing internals, allocation, canonical output sorting, verification, and export costs.
indexedRows/sortedRows count indexed row references or sorted records, not bytes or measured peak memory. Merge sorting also uses a scratch array of the same total row count.
One bounded execution per method; no statistical timing claim, cost saving, model discovery, or external certification.
CSV exports prefix formula-like cells with an apostrophe for spreadsheet safety; exact JSON preserves original strings.
